observations: Single photo shows a kids' bicycle with white frame, blue seat, and white rims.
Bike has training wheels (small stabilizer wheel visible near rear wheel).
Photo taken indoors on tiled floor with clothes/curtain in background, not a clean studio shot.
No brand or model text is legible anywhere on the frame.
Tires appear inflated but tread and wear details are not clear from this distance.
Some surface dirt/scuff visible on frame and seat; no close-up of rust or structural damage.
Chain, pedals and brake cables are only partially visible, not close enough to assess condition.

claims.claim: A strong neatly used kids bicycle
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows overall shape but no close-up of frame joints, welds, or rust spots to confirm 'strong'; 'neatly used' is subjective and not provable from a single distant shot.

risks.risk: Frame or weld damage (bends, cracks, rust) not visible at this distance
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, especially near pedals and seat post
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible structural wear

risks.risk: Tire and tube condition (cracks, flat spots, needs replacement)
risks.proof: Close-up of both tires including tread and sidewalls

risks.risk: Brake functionality (if hand brakes or coaster brake work)
risks.proof: Video clip of brakes being applied while wheel spins
Close-up of chain and a clip of pedals turning freely
Close-up of training wheel mounting bolts

proof_requests: Close-up photos of both tires and wheel rims
Close-up of frame welds and any rust spots
Video clip showing pedals turning and brakes engaging
Photo of the full bike from a few more angles in good lighting
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used kids' bicycle with training wheels; though seller's 'strong' and 'neatly used' claims are unverified, this does not block pricing since it can be valued at worst-case condition pending further proof.
